overfit_capacity_test.subset: 2 episodes per each of 27 joint endpoint classes

conclusions: The direct M=128 recurrent implementation has a valid gradient and capacity path: it can memorize the 54-example subset and preserves diverse memory tokens.
Its 54-example solution does not generalize to held-out episodes, so the current updater has not learned a reusable swap transition rule.
The one-shot model's first-swap advantage is not reproduced merely by adding shared recurrent calls; recurrence alone is insufficient under the present supervision and optimization schedule.

The next clean separation is an oracle-initial-state transition test: initialize the hidden cup state from ground-truth, feed only swap segments, and test whether the shared updater can apply the visible cup permutation three times.
